TO: Controller
FROM: Senior Accountant (david.murguia@gmail.com)
DATE: 2026-04-03
RE: Q1 2026 board deck vs GL — US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200)

SUMMARY
The deck figure (USD 11,769.00) and today's GL (USD 14,569.00) differ by USD 2,800.00. The difference is fully explained by one AP entry posted after the deck was pulled. Neither figure is the correct final Q1 number: the March Figtree prepaid amortization (USD 1,250.00) has not yet been booked. Correct Q1 2026 US GL 6200 = USD 15,819.00. No entries were posted.

TRACE
1. Board deck (DOC-0207, Appendix B): "Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026: USD 11,769.00 — prepared by FP&A from the GL as of 2026-04-01 09:00."
2. GL 6200 US today (get_account_balance): Jan 4,289.70 + Feb 4,139.80 + Mar 6,139.50 = USD 14,569.00 cumulative through 2026-03.
3. Difference: 14,569.00 − 11,769.00 = USD 2,800.00.

WHAT EXPLAINS THE DIFFERENCE
JE-00304 — Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP, "Q1 seat true-up (14 additional seats, Jan–Mar)", Dr 6200 / Cr 2000 USD 2,800.00. Dated 2026-03-31 (period 2026-03) but created 2026-04-02 10:14 by ap.clerk — i.e., ~25 hours after FP&A extracted the deck. Support: DOC-0206 (vendor invoice, service period Jan–Mar 2026). The entry is legitimate and correctly belongs in Q1; the deck simply predates it. 11,769.00 + 2,800.00 = 14,569.00 ties exactly, so nothing else changed in 6200 between the deck pull and today.

FULL Q1 6200 COMPOSITION (19 posted entries, all with support)
- Zoom corporate card charges: 10 × USD 149.90 = 1,499.00 (Jan 3, Feb 2, Mar 5). Note: two charges on 2026-03-08 (JE-00247/JE-00248) are NOT duplicates — bank shows two separate CARD ZOOM debits that day (BT-US-0062, BT-US-0063), each with its own receipt (DOC-0173, DOC-0174).
- Quire Docs monthly: 3 × 640.00 = 1,920.00 (JE-00035, JE-00127, JE-00229)
- Tessellate BI monthly: 3 × 1,950.00 = 5,850.00 (JE-00027, JE-00140, JE-00237)
- Tessellate BI Q1 true-up: 2,800.00 (JE-00304)
- Figtree prepaid amortization: 2 × 1,250.00 = 2,500.00 (JE-00108 Jan, JE-00204 Feb)
Total = USD 14,569.00

CORRECT Q1 FIGURE
The GL is still incomplete for March. Per the prepaid software amortization schedule (DOC-0067; Figtree annual license FIG-20260105, USD 15,000 / 12 = 1,250.00 per month, Dr 6200 / Cr 1210), Jan and Feb are booked and March is "to be booked at March close." No March amortization exists in 1210 or 6200, and the US checklist item "Amortize prepaid software" remains open.

  Deck (GL at 04-01 09:00)                     USD 11,769.00
  + JE-00304 Tessellate Q1 true-up (posted 04-02)   2,800.00
  = GL today                                    USD 14,569.00
  + Figtree March amortization (not yet booked)     1,250.00
  = Correct Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions   USD 15,819.00

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Update the board deck from 11,769.00 to 15,819.00 (or at minimum footnote it as pre-close), and have FP&A re-pull after the March close is complete rather than from an open period.
2. Book the March Figtree amortization (Dr 6200 / Cr 1210, USD 1,250.00, support DOC-0067/DOC-0024) as part of the open "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item — not posted here per your instruction of no postings.
3. AP cutoff: JE-00304 was appropriately dated 03-31, but late-arriving Q1 true-up invoices should be communicated to FP&A before deck extraction.

No exceptions flagged: every entry in 6200 is supported and the residual gap is a known, scheduled close task.
